title: 旧事.
slug: 姜姬全本免费-姜姬最新章节列表
content_zh:
山坡上的草都变青了，干涸的小河也有了破冰的声音。似乎连天都变蓝了呢。
“风都是暖的。”姜姬兴高采烈的站在山坡顶，迎面吹来徐徐的春风，现在出来也不会冻脸了。
“我抱你吧，这木屐还是走不惯吧？”姜武说。
姜姬抬起脚，“包上皮子就好多了。”她不肯穿木屐，觉得太硬、磨脚，姜元就割了块牛皮把木屐包了一下让她穿。
初春的太阳也似乎要大一些，姜武举着伞，“别跑别跑，这伞沉着呢。”
“正好让你练练臂力。”姜姬知道姜武和姜奔经过这近半年的锻炼后早已脱胎换骨，这伞柄是用中空的毛竹做的，以前他们举不起来是臂力不够，现在轻轻松松就能举上一个时辰。
她笑着跑起来，姜武早防着她，紧紧跟上，笑话她：“终于会穿木屐了？”
沿着缓坡，她跑到了另一座山的西面，姜武突然喊住她，“等等！那边好像有人来了！”
他说的没错，山脚下不是来了一个人，而是来了一列车队。
从人突然在车外喊，“冯公，那边山上有人。”
冯丙从车中下来，望着远处的山坡，“叫展用来，让他看看那是什么。”展用是他的队伍里能看得最远的人。
展用坐在马上，被人一叫就赶紧跳下来，他比旁人矮小，却有一双猿臂，尤擅强弓。他跑到冯丙身边，冯丙指着那边道：“你看看那边是什么。”
展用举目远眺，少顷便道：“冯公，是一位小公子带着一个从人，从人举着罗伞。”
罗伞？！这种地方，什么人会用罗伞？！
冯丙高声叫道：“快牵马来！展用与我来！”
立刻有两匹马牵来，冯丙与展用飞身上马，展用要配弓箭，冯丙制止他道：“不可！”如果真是他想的那样，那带着弓箭说不定会适得其反，他不但不让展用带弓箭，还把自己身上的剑和匕首也给取下来了，还特意取来帽子戴上，“走！”
“他们过来了！”姜武咬咬牙，他知道这两人骑的是马，以前来村里抓男人的军队就有人骑马，骑马的人跑得快，他们跑不过马。
“你站到那边。”姜武握着手里的伞柄，只要等他们下马……
姜姬听他的站到不远处，遥望着来人。
冯丙与展用策马很快就来到这两人面前，当看到那个静静矗立的女公子时，冯丙浑身的血都要沸腾了！在这样的乡野之间，怎么会有这样一位雅致的女公子？

姜武向前一步，大声喝道：“来者通名！！”
冯丙忙道：“通州冯氏，冯丙。”
展用是从人，自然不必报名。
姜武也没有开口。冯丙只看姜姬，她的眉眼之间，竟然与……
姜姬记得姜元教过，“姜姬。”
冯丙激动的就要上前，姜武抓住时机把伞猛得扫过去！展用一直盯着姜武，从后面抓住冯丙的衣服往后使劲一甩，两人顿时滚地葫芦般滚下山坡，姜武趁胜追击，举着伞连连横扫突刺，展用只得拖住冯丙连滚带爬，靠近马时，姜武趁机击中马的鼻子，惊走的马。
马咴咴叫着跑了，姜武见马跑了，回身扛起姜姬就跑，手上还拖着那柄伞。只是伞盖早在刚才的打斗中掉了，正好只剩下毛竹柄，当棍子使还有些嫌轻呢，他大步如飞，转眼间就跑过山坡不见影子了。
展用此时才把头昏脑胀的冯丙扶起来，“冯公无恙？”
冯丙扶着头，刚才跌得浑身疼，喘道：“人呢？”
展用摇头，“跑了。”他去捡了那掉下的伞盖，拾回来给冯丙看。
“九十九道伞骨。”冯丙摸着伞盖，欣喜的笑起来，“天佑我等啊！”
既然找着了，那也不必急了。冯丙被展用扶下山坡，更衣、梳头，还让车队的从人全都换了新衣后，才整整齐齐的向前走。
“就在这里了，慢慢找，如果遇上人，千万不要惊动了他们，更不可失礼！”冯丙道。
姜武扛着姜姬在山中绕了两圈才气喘吁吁的向家跑。离家不远，姜奔已经听到声音迎过来了，经过兵祸，一看到姜武神色不对，姜奔吓得声调都变了：“是不是当兵的来了？！来抓人了吗？”
他喊出来，顿时所有人都跑出来了。姜谷、姜粟从屋后出来，满面惊惶；姜元从屋里出来，一脸严肃，陶氏整个人都吓瘫了，却最快反应过来，对姜谷和姜粟喊：“立刻把粮食装进袋子里给他们！”然后扑到姜元脚下抱住他喊：“你快跑！快带着粮食跑！”

content_en:
The grass on the hillside has turned green, and the dry river has the sound of ice breaking. It seems that even the sky has turned blue.
"The wind is warm." Jiang Ji stood happily on the top of the hillside, facing the gentle spring breeze. Now she would not be cold when she came out.
"Let me hug you. You still can't get used to walking on these clogs, right?" Jiang Wu said.
Jiang Ji raised her feet and said, "It would be much better if they were wrapped in leather." She refused to wear the clogs because they were too hard and abrasive to her feet, so Jiang Yuan cut off a piece of cowhide and wrapped the clogs for her to wear.
The sun seemed to be brighter in early spring. Jiang Wu held up the umbrella and said, "Don't run, don't run. This umbrella is calm."
"Just for you to practice your arm strength." Jiang Ji knew that Jiang Wu and Jiang Ben had transformed after nearly half a year of training. The umbrella handle was made of hollow bamboo. In the past, they couldn't lift it because their arm strength was insufficient. Now they can easily lift it for an hour.
She smiled and started running. Jiang Wu had been on guard against her and kept up with her, laughing at her: "Finally know how to wear clogs?"
Along the gentle slope, she ran to the west of another mountain. Jiang Wu suddenly called out to her, "Wait! Someone seems to be coming over there!"
What he said was right, it was not a person who came to the foot of the mountain, but a motorcade.
The servant suddenly shouted from outside the car, "Mr. Feng, there is someone on the mountain over there."
Feng Bing got out of the car and looked at the hillside in the distance, "Call Zhan Yong and let him see what it is." Zhan Yong was the person in his team who could see the farthest.
Zhan Yong sat on the horse and jumped off when called. He was shorter than others, but had a pair of ape arms and was especially good at using a strong bow. He ran to Feng Bing, who pointed over there and said, "Look what's over there."
Zhan Yong raised his eyes and looked into the distance, and after a while he said: "Mr. Feng, he is a young master with a servant, and the servant is holding an umbrella."
Luo umbrella? ! Who would use an umbrella in a place like this? !
Feng Bing shouted loudly: "Hurry up and bring the horse! Zhanyong is coming with me!"
Two horses came immediately. Feng Bing and Zhan Yong flew up. Zhan Yong asked for a bow and arrow. Feng Bing stopped him and said, "No!" If that was what he thought, bringing a bow and arrow might be counterproductive. Not only did he not let Zhan Yong bring a bow and arrow, he also took off his sword and dagger, and even took a hat to put on, "Let's go!"
"They are coming!" Jiang Wu gritted his teeth. He knew that these two people were riding horses. The army that came to the village to capture men in the past had people riding horses. The people on horseback ran fast, and they could not outrun the horses.
"Stand over there." Jiang Wu held the umbrella handle in his hand, waiting for them to dismount...
Jiang Ji listened to him and stood not far away, looking at the person coming from a distance.
Feng Bing and Zhan Yong rode their horses and quickly arrived in front of these two people. When they saw the young lady standing quietly, the blood in Feng Bing's body was about to boil! How could there be such an elegant young lady in such a countryside?
Jiang Wu took a step forward and shouted loudly: "Everyone who comes here will be named!!"
Feng Bing said hurriedly: "Tongzhou Feng family, Feng Bing."
The exhibition is open to the public, so there is no need to sign up.
Jiang Wu didn't speak either. Feng Bing only looked at Jiang Ji. There was something between her eyebrows and...
Jiang Ji remembered Jiang Yuan’s teaching, “Jiang Ji.”
Feng Bing was about to step forward in excitement, but Jiang Wu seized the opportunity and swept the umbrella over! Zhan Yong kept staring at Jiang Wu, grabbed Feng Bing's clothes from behind and swung it hard, and the two of them rolled down the hillside like gourds. Jiang Wu took advantage of the victory and pursued him, holding up an umbrella and sweeping the thrusts repeatedly. Zhan Yong had to drag Feng Bing and crawled. When he got close to the horse, Jiang Wu took the opportunity to hit the horse's nose, causing the horse to run away in shock.
The horse screamed and ran away. When Jiang Wu saw the horse running away, he turned around, picked up Jiang Ji and ran away, still dragging the umbrella in his hand. But the umbrella cover had fallen off in the previous fight, leaving only the bamboo handle, which was a little too light to use as a stick. He strode like flying, and in the blink of an eye, he ran across the hillside and disappeared.
Only then did Zhan Yong help the dizzy Feng Bing up, "Is Mr. Feng okay?"
Feng Bing held his head, his whole body hurt from the fall just now, and he gasped: "Where are the people?"
Zhan Yong shook his head and said, "Run away." He went to pick up the fallen umbrella cover and brought it back to show Feng Bing.
"Ninety-nine umbrella ribs." Feng Bing touched the umbrella cover and smiled happily, "God bless me for waiting!"
Now that you've found it, there's no need to worry. Feng Bing was helped down the hillside by Zhanyong, changed his clothes, combed his hair, and asked all the people in the team to change into new clothes before he walked forward neatly.
"It's right here, look for it slowly. If you meet someone, don't alert them, and don't be rude!" Feng Bing said.
Jiang Wu carried Jiang Ji around the mountain twice before running home panting. Not far from home, Jiang Ben had already heard the sound and came over. After the military disaster, when he saw Jiang Wu looking wrong, Jiang Ben was so frightened that his tone changed: "Are the soldiers coming?! Are you here to arrest someone?"
He shouted, and everyone immediately ran out. Jiang Gu and Jiang Su came out from the back of the house with panic on their faces; Jiang Yuan came out of the house with a serious look on his face. Mrs. Tao was paralyzed with fear, but she reacted quickly and shouted to Jiang Gu and Jiang Su: "Put the grain into bags for them immediately!" Then she threw herself at Jiang Yuan's feet and hugged him, shouting: "Run! Run with the grain!"
